entries.wording: Shipping label created - OSM awaiting item
entries.note: The shipper's label, before OSM has the parcel.
Each OSM facility the parcel reaches, the first as well.
The hand-over to the last mile partner, which the tracker does not name.
The last mile partner takes the parcel from OSM, after OSM's own facility scans: no acceptance.

entries.wording: Package left courier partner and is on its way
entries.note: A last mile partner's scan. It can come days before the delivery, so it is not taken as out for delivery.
The last mile partner's delivery round.
OSM's FAQ says this scan is made when the label is uploaded and does not mean OSM has the parcel.
